```{r setup, include=FALSE}
.cpu_paths <- c(file.path(dirname(Sys.getenv("STAGES_DIR")),"cpu_budget.R"),
                file.path(Sys.getenv("PMX_TOOLKIT"),"word-report","cpu_budget.R"),
                ".pmx/word-report/cpu_budget.R", ".pmx/pmx_workspace/word-report/cpu_budget.R",
                "../.pmx/pmx_workspace/word-report/cpu_budget.R", "word-report/cpu_budget.R")
.cpu_path <- .cpu_paths[file.exists(.cpu_paths)][1]
if(is.na(.cpu_path)) stop("PMX_CPU_TOOLKIT_REQUIRED: complete reusable toolkit required")
source(.cpu_path)
pmx_cpu_setup(threads=1L)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(error=FALSE,
  echo = FALSE,          # report output; set TRUE to show the code
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  fig.width = 9,
  fig.height = 6,
  fig.align = "center"
)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)      # data manipulation
  library(tidyr)      # pivot_longer / pivot_wider
  library(tibble)     # rownames_to_column / tribble
  library(ggplot2)    # forest plots / exposure-response plots
  library(stringr)    # coefficient-name cleanup
  library(knitr)      # kable tables (the Word extractor reads these)
  library(survival)   # Surv / survfit / coxph
  library(survminer)  # ggsurvplot
  library(cowplot)    # plot_grid
  library(scales)     # percent / label_number
})
```

DATA_FILE <- Sys.getenv("PMX_DATA", "")      # NULL = auto-discover the study's csv (see the adapter).
OUT_DIR   <- Sys.getenv("PMX_OUTPUT_DIR", "output")

RUN_EFFEC  <- TRUE    # exposure-efficacy: every endpoint in END_DEF the table carries
RUN_SAFETY <- TRUE
SAFETY_MODEL_ENDPOINTS <- "SAE"
SAFETY_DEF <- list(
  list(var = "SAE",      lab = "Serious adverse events (SAE)"),
  list(var = "TEAEG3",   lab = ">= Grade 3 TEAE",                    time = "TEAEG3TIME"),
  list(var = "TRAEG3",   lab = ">= Grade 3 TRAE",                    time = "TRAEG3TIME"),
  list(var = "INFG3",    lab = ">= Grade 3 infections",              time = "INFG3TIME"),
  list(var = "HEMG3",    lab = "Major haemorrhage"),
  list(var = "ANEMIAG3", lab = ">= Grade 3 anaemia"),
  list(var = "NEUTG3",   lab = ">= Grade 3 neutropenia",             time = "NEUTG3TIME"),
  list(var = "THROMBG3", lab = ">= Grade 3 thrombocytopenia"),
  list(var = "SPM",      lab = "Second primary malignancies"),
  list(var = "AFG3",     lab = ">= Grade 3 atrial fibrillation / flutter"),
  list(var = "HYPERTG3", lab = ">= Grade 3 hypertension")
)
RUN_SAFETY_TTE <- FALSE  # also draw the Kaplan-Meier curve (cumulative incidence by
RUN_REGRESSION <- TRUE   # the model-based part (logistic / Cox). OPTIONAL: with FALSE the

RUN_DOR    <- TRUE    # keep the DoR endpoint

  list(kind = "tte", timevar = "DORMIN", evvar = "DOREVT", label = "DoR",

       short = "pfs", direction = "down"),

  list(kind = "tte", timevar = "UMRDTIME", evvar = "UMRDEVT", label = "Time to uMRD",

  OSTIME   = c("OS_TIME", "OSTIM", "SURVTIME", "OS"),

valid_safety_endpoint <- function(definition) {
  is.list(definition) && is.character(definition$var) &&
    length(definition$var)==1L && !is.na(definition$var) && nzchar(definition$var) &&
    is.character(definition$lab) && length(definition$lab)==1L &&
    !is.na(definition$lab) && nzchar(definition$lab) &&
    (is.null(definition$time) || (is.character(definition$time) &&
      length(definition$time)==1L && !is.na(definition$time) && nzchar(definition$time)))
}
if(!is.list(SAFETY_DEF) || !all(vapply(SAFETY_DEF,valid_safety_endpoint,TRUE)) ||
   anyDuplicated(toupper(vapply(SAFETY_DEF,function(x) x$var,""))))
  stop("SAFETY_DEF must define unique endpoints with var, lab and optional time fields")
if (length(SCREEN_P) != 1L || (!is.numeric(SCREEN_P) && !is.na(SCREEN_P)) ||
    (!is.na(SCREEN_P) && (!is.finite(SCREEN_P) || SCREEN_P <= 0 || SCREEN_P >= 1)))
  stop("SCREEN_P must be a probability between 0 and 1, or NA")
if(length(intersect(CON_COV,CAT_COV))) stop("A covariate cannot be continuous and categorical")
if(any(c(DOSE_VAR,"DOSEF") %in% ALL_COV)) stop("Declare dose as descriptive or explicitly revise the analysis plan")

```{r read-data}
if (is.null(DATA_FILE) || !nzchar(DATA_FILE)) {
  cand <- list.files(".", pattern = "\\.csv$", ignore.case = TRUE)
  cand <- cand[!grepl("^(tbl_|html_tbl_|labels[.]csv$|endpoints[.]csv$|safety_endpoints[.]csv$|covariates[.]csv$|nca_initials[.]csv$|ladder_table[.]csv$)",cand)]
  if (!length(cand))
    stop("ER_SCHEMA_NO_DATA: no *.csv in ", getwd(),
         " — put the study's subject-level table here.")
  pref <- grep("(^|[_-])er([_-]|$)|expos|response", cand, ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)
  DATA_FILE <- if (length(pref)) pref[1] else if (length(cand) == 1) cand[1] else
    stop("ER_SCHEMA_AMBIGUOUS_DATA: several csv present (",
         paste(cand, collapse = ", "), ") — set DATA_FILE in the switches chunk.")
}
message("ER_SCHEMA_DATA ", DATA_FILE)
er_all <- read.csv(DATA_FILE, na.strings = c("", ".", "NA", "unknown", "not reported", "missing"),
                   check.names = FALSE)

pick <- function(nms, alts) {
  for (a in alts) { i <- which(toupper(nms) == toupper(a)); if (length(i)) return(nms[i[1]]) }
  NULL
}
ER_SOURCE_NAMES <- character(0)
adopt <- function(d, canon, alts) {
  hit <- pick(names(d), c(canon, alts))
  if (!is.null(hit)) {
    ER_SOURCE_NAMES[canon] <<- hit
    names(d)[names(d) == hit] <- canon
  }
  d
}
ER_ALIAS <- list(
  SUBJID   = c("USUBJID", "SUBJIDN", "SUBJECT", "PATIENT", "ID"),
  TRT      = c("TRTNAME", "TREATMENT", "ARM"),
  DOSE     = c("DOSE_MG", "DOSELEVEL", "DOSEMG", "DOSE_ADMIN", "DOSEF"),
  ORR      = c("RESPONSE", "OR_RESP", "RESPRESP", "OR"),
  DORMIN   = c("DOR_DUR", "DOR_DURATION", "DURATION", "DOR"),
  DOREVT   = c("DOR_EVENT", "DOREVENT", "DORCNSR"),
  PFSTIME  = c("PFS_TIME", "PFSTIM", "PROGTIME", "PFS"),
  PFSEVT   = c("PFS_EVENT", "PFSEVENT", "PFSCNSR"),
  OSTIME   = c("OS_TIME", "OSTIM", "SURVTIME", "OS"),
  OSEVT    = c("OS_EVENT", "OSEVENT", "OSCNSR"),
  WC       = c("WGTBL", "WEIGHT", "WTBL", "BWT", "WGTRL"),
  AGE      = c("AGEBL", "AGE_YEARS", "AGEYR"),
  SEX      = c("SEXCD", "GENDER"),
  RACE     = c("RACECD", "RACEN"),
  REGION   = c("COUNTRY", "GEOGRAPHICREGION"),
  ECOGBL   = c("ECOG", "ECOG_BL", "ECOGPS"),
  BSA      = c("BSABL", "BSA_M2"),
  ALB      = c("ALBUMIN", "ALBBL"),
  CRCL     = c("CRCLBL", "CRCL_MLMIN", "CRCLBL1"),
  BMI      = c("BMIBL", "BMI_KGM2"),
  LDH      = c("LDHBL", "LDH_UL"),
  HGB      = c("HGBBL", "HEMOGLOBIN"),
  NEUT     = c("NEUTBL", "ANC", "NEUTROPHIL"),
  PLT      = c("PLTBL", "PLATELET", "PLATELETS"),
  NPTRLINE = c("PRIORLINES", "NPRIORLINES", "NUMPRIOR"),
  DISSTG   = c("STAGE", "DISEASESTAGE"),
  BRAINM   = c("BRAINMET", "BMETS", "CNSMETS"),
  AGEGR1   = c("AGE_GRP", "AGEGROUP")
)
for (cn in names(ER_ALIAS)) er_all <- adopt(er_all, cn, ER_ALIAS[[cn]])

EXPO_ALIAS <- c("CAVG24HSS", "CAVGSS", "CAVG_SS", "CAVG24", "CAVG", "CAVGBL", "CAVGB",
                "AUCSS", "AUC_SS", "AUC", "AUCLAST", "AUCTAU", "CMAX24HSS", "CMAX", "CMAXSS",
                "EXPOSURE", "EXPO", "CONC", "CONCSS", "PREDOSE_CONC")
if (!PK_EXPO %in% names(er_all)) {
  hit <- pick(names(er_all), EXPO_ALIAS)
  if (!is.null(hit)) {
    PK_EXPO <- hit
    if(!nzchar(PK_EXPO_LAB)) PK_EXPO_LAB <- hit
    message("ER_SCHEMA_EXPO ", hit, " -> ", PK_EXPO)
  }
}
if (!PK_EXPO_EOT %in% names(er_all)) {
  hit <- pick(names(er_all), c("CAVG_EOT", "CAVGEOT", "EXPO_EOT", "CAVGEOTIND"))
  if (!is.null(hit)) names(er_all)[names(er_all) == hit] <- PK_EXPO_EOT
}

if(!nzchar(PK_EXPO_LAB)) PK_EXPO_LAB <- PK_EXPO
for (cn in c("STUDYID", "TRT", "DOSE", "ORR", "EXCLREAS", "ECOGBL", "AGEGR1", "SEX",
             "RACE", "REGION", "DISSTG", "BRAINM", "NPTRLINE", "LDH", "NEUT", "WC",
             PK_EXPO, PK_EXPO_EOT))
  if (!cn %in% names(er_all)) er_all[[cn]] <- NA

.first_ok <- function(x) { x <- unique(x[!is.na(x) & nzchar(as.character(x))]); if (length(x)) as.character(x)[1] else NA_character_ }
if (!nzchar(DRUG)) {
  DRUG <- if ("TRT" %in% names(er_all))
            sub("[[:space:]]*[0-9].*$", "", .first_ok(er_all$TRT)) else NA_character_
  DRUG <- if (is.na(DRUG) || !nzchar(DRUG) || tolower(DRUG)=="drug") "study treatment" else DRUG
}
if (!nzchar(STUDY)) {
  STUDY <- if ("STUDYID" %in% names(er_all)) paste(unique(as.character(er_all$STUDYID[!is.na(er_all$STUDYID)])),collapse=", ") else NA_character_
  STUDY <- if (is.na(STUDY)) "the study" else STUDY
}
if (!nzchar(INDICATION)) {
  INDICATION <- if ("INDICATION" %in% names(er_all)) .first_ok(er_all$INDICATION) else NA_character_
  INDICATION <- if (is.na(INDICATION)) "the study population" else INDICATION
}
DRUG_LOW <- strsplit(DRUG, "[[:space:]]+")[[1]][1]   # set with DRUG, above
cat("ER_LABELS", DRUG, "|", STUDY, "|", INDICATION, "\n")
dir.create(OUT_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE)
write.csv(data.frame(key = c("DRUG", "STUDY", "INDICATION", "PROJECT"),
                     value = c(DRUG, STUDY, INDICATION, STUDY), stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
          file.path(OUT_DIR, "labels.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

for (cn in c("PKFL", "EFFFL", "SAFEFL")) if (!cn %in% names(er_all)) er_all[[cn]] <- 1

flag01 <- function(x) {
  v <- toupper(trimws(as.character(x)))
  ifelse(v %in% c("1","Y","YES","TRUE","T"),1L,ifelse(v %in% c("0","N","NO","FALSE","F"),0L,NA_integer_))
}
for(v in c("PKFL","EFFFL","SAFEFL")) er_all[[v]] <- flag01(er_all[[v]])
if(!"SUBJID" %in% names(er_all) || anyNA(er_all$SUBJID) || anyDuplicated(er_all$SUBJID)) stop("ER requires one row per subject and a unique nonmissing SUBJID")
pop_pk  <- er_all %>% filter(PKFL == 1)
pop_eff <- er_all %>% filter(EFFFL == 1)
pop_saf <- er_all %>% filter(SAFEFL == 1)

n_all <- nrow(er_all); n_pk <- nrow(pop_pk); n_eff <- nrow(pop_eff); n_saf <- nrow(pop_saf)

present <- function(v) v %in% names(er_all)
num <- function(x) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
HAVE_EXPO <- present(PK_EXPO) && any(is.finite(num(er_all[[PK_EXPO]])))
HAVE_EXPO_EFF <- any(is.finite(num(pop_eff[[PK_EXPO]])))
HAVE_EOT  <- present(PK_EXPO_EOT) && any(is.finite(num(pop_eff[[PK_EXPO_EOT]])))

as01 <- function(x) {
  if (is.numeric(x)) return(ifelse(x %in% c(0,1),as.numeric(x),NA_real_))
  s <- toupper(trimws(as.character(x)))
  out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(s))
  out[s %in% c("Y", "YES", "TRUE", "T")] <- 1
  out[s %in% c("N", "NO", "FALSE", "F")]  <- 0
  out[!out %in% c(0,1)] <- NA_real_
  out
}
as_event <- function(x, colname) {
  v <- as01(x)
  source_name <- if(colname %in% names(ER_SOURCE_NAMES)) ER_SOURCE_NAMES[[colname]] else colname
  if (grepl("CNSR|CENS", toupper(source_name))) v <- 1 - v
  v
}
find_col <- function(canon, alts = NULL)
  pick(names(er_all), unique(c(canon, alts, END_TTE_ALIAS[[canon]])))
usable_bin <- function(var, alts = NULL) {
  cn <- find_col(var, alts)
  if (is.null(cn)) return(NULL)
  v <- as01(pop_eff[[cn]]); v <- v[!is.na(v)]
  if (length(v) < 3 || length(unique(v)) < 2) return(NULL)
  cn
}
usable_tte <- function(timevar, evvar) {
  tn <- find_col(timevar); en <- find_col(evvar)
  if (is.null(tn) || is.null(en)) return(NULL)
  ev <- as_event(pop_eff[[en]], en); tm <- num(pop_eff[[tn]])
  if (sum(ev == 1, na.rm = TRUE) < 1 || sum(is.finite(tm)) < 3) return(NULL)
  list(time = tn, event = en)
}

resolve_endpoints <- function(def = END_DEF) {
  out <- list()
  for (d in def) {
    if (d$kind == "binary") {
      cn <- usable_bin(d$var, d$alts)
      if (is.null(cn)) { message("ER_SCHEMA_SKIP ", d$label,
                                 " (no usable binary column ", d$var, ")"); next }
      d$col <- cn; d$var <- cn
      d$short <- d$short %||% tolower(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "", d$label))
    } else {
      hit <- usable_tte(d$timevar, d$evvar)
      if (is.null(hit)) { message("ER_SCHEMA_SKIP ", d$label, " (no usable ",
                                  d$timevar, "/", d$evvar, " pair)"); next }
      d$timevar <- hit$time; d$evvar <- hit$event
      d$short <- d$short %||% tolower(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "", d$label))
    }
    out[[length(out) + 1]] <- d
  }
  drop_if_off <- function(out, label, on) if (on) out else
    out[!vapply(out, function(e) e$label == label, logical(1))]
  out <- drop_if_off(out, "ORR", RUN_ORR)
  out <- drop_if_off(out, "DoR", RUN_DOR)
  out <- drop_if_off(out, "PFS", RUN_PFS)
  if (isTRUE(END_AUTO)) {
    has <- function(out, tv) any(vapply(out, function(e) e$kind == "tte" &&
                                          e$timevar == tv, logical(1)))
    for (e in out) {
      if (e$kind != "binary") next
      cand_time <- c(paste0(e$col, "TIME"), paste0(e$col, "_TIME"),
                     paste0("T_", e$col), paste0("TIME_TO_", e$col),
                     paste0(e$col, "DUR"), paste0(e$col, "TIM"))
      cand_evt  <- c(paste0(e$col, "EVT"), paste0(e$col, "_EVENT"),
                     paste0(e$col, "_EVT"), paste0(e$col, "STATUS"),
                     paste0(e$col, "_STATUS"))
      tn <- pick(names(er_all), cand_time); en <- pick(names(er_all), cand_evt)
      if (is.null(tn) || is.null(en) || has(out, tn)) next
      hit <- usable_tte(tn, en)
      if (is.null(hit)) next
      lab <- paste0("Time to ", e$label)
      message("ER_SCHEMA_AUTO_TTE ", lab, " (", hit$time, "/", hit$event, ")")
      out[[length(out) + 1]] <- list(kind = "tte", label = lab,
                                     timevar = hit$time, evvar = hit$event,
                                     short = tolower(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "",
                                                          paste0("t", e$label))),
                                     direction = "up")
    }
  }
  out
}

`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a)) b else a
EPS <- resolve_endpoints()
HAVE_ORR <- any(vapply(EPS, function(e) e$label == "ORR", logical(1)))
HAVE_DOR <- any(vapply(EPS, function(e) e$label == "DoR", logical(1)))
HAVE_PFS <- any(vapply(EPS, function(e) e$label == "PFS", logical(1)))
HAVE_OS  <- any(vapply(EPS, function(e) e$label == "OS", logical(1)))
if (!length(EPS)) message("ER_SCHEMA_NO_ENDPOINT: none of the declared endpoints is in ",
                          DATA_FILE, " — the efficacy sections are omitted")
if (!HAVE_EXPO)
  stop("ER_SCHEMA_NO_EXPOSURE: no usable exposure metric in ", DATA_FILE,
       "\n  looked for: ", PK_EXPO, " and ", paste(EXPO_ALIAS, collapse = ", "),
       "\n  columns present: ", paste(names(er_all), collapse = ", "),
       "\n  -> set PK_EXPO in the switches chunk to the study's exposure column.")
if (LOGPK && any(num(pop_eff[[PK_EXPO]]) <= 0, na.rm = TRUE)) {
  LOGPK <- FALSE
  message("ER_SCHEMA_LOGPK_OFF exposure has non-positive values — modelling it untransformed")
}
RUN_EFFEC <- RUN_EFFEC && length(EPS) > 0 && HAVE_EXPO_EFF
cat("ER_ENDPOINTS", paste(vapply(EPS, function(e) paste0(e$label, "(", e$kind, ")"),
                                 character(1)), collapse = " | "), "\n")

dose_label <- function(v) {
  x <- num(v)
  if (!length(x) || all(is.na(x))) "" else paste0(", ", max(x, na.rm = TRUE), " mg")
}
medrng <- function(x) {
  x <- num(x); x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (!length(x)) "n.a." else
    paste0(er_format_coef(median(x)), " [", er_format_coef(min(x)), ", ", er_format_coef(max(x)), "]")
}


# Categorical reference levels
mode_level <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x); x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (!length(x)) return(NA_character_)
  names(sort(table(x), decreasing = TRUE))[[1]]
}
cat_counts <- function(d, v) {
  lv <- as.character(d[[v]]); lv <- lv[!is.na(lv)]
  if (!length(lv))
    return(data.frame(level = character(0), N = integer(0), rank = integer(0),
                      stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
  tb <- sort(table(lv), decreasing = TRUE)
  data.frame(level = names(tb), N = as.integer(tb), rank = seq_along(tb),
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
# Fitted reference level
cat_ref_level <- function(d, v, fit = NULL) {
  if (!is.null(fit)) {
    mf <- tryCatch(stats::model.frame(fit), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(mf) && v %in% names(mf) && is.factor(mf[[v]])) return(levels(mf[[v]])[1])
  }
  x <- d[[v]]
  lv <- if (is.factor(x)) levels(x) else levels(factor(as.character(x)))
  if (length(lv)) lv[1] else NA_character_
}
# Coefficient level
cat_level_of_term <- function(d, v, term) {
  x <- d[[v]]
  lvls <- if (is.factor(x)) levels(x) else levels(factor(as.character(x)))
  cand <- lvls[vapply(lvls, function(l) identical(paste0(v, l), as.character(term)),
                      logical(1))]
  if (length(cand)) return(cand[which.max(nchar(cand))])
  sub(paste0("^", v), "", as.character(term))
}
# "<level> : <reference> (N = n : n_ref)" - the numbers are read off the data frame.
cat_effect_label <- function(d, v, level, ref = NULL, fit = NULL) {
  if(!is.null(fit)) {mf <- model.frame(fit); d <- d[match(rownames(mf),rownames(d)),,drop=FALSE]}
  cc <- cat_counts(d, v)
  if (is.null(ref)) ref <- cat_ref_level(d, v, fit)
  n_of <- function(l) {
    i <- which(cc$level == as.character(l))
    if (length(i)) cc$N[i[1]] else NA_integer_
  }
  sprintf("%s : %s (N = %d : %d)", cat_level_display(v, level), cat_level_display(v, ref),
          n_of(level), n_of(ref))
}
ref_wanted <- function(v) {
  if (is.null(COV_REF) || !length(COV_REF)) return("modal")
  if (length(COV_REF) == 1 && (is.null(names(COV_REF)) || !nzchar(names(COV_REF)[1]))) return(as.character(COV_REF)[1])
  if (v %in% names(COV_REF)) return(as.character(COV_REF[[v]]))
  "modal"
}
# The printed name of a categorical level (COV_LEVELS map; unlisted levels print as-is).
cat_level_display <- function(v, l) {
  m <- COV_LEVELS[[v]]
  l <- as.character(l)
  hit <- match(l, names(m))
  ifelse(is.na(hit), l, as.character(m[hit]))
}
# Factor reference levels
set_cat_ref <- function(d, vars, ref = NULL) {
  releveled <- character(0)
  for (v in intersect(vars, names(d))) {
    x <- d[[v]]
    if(!v %in% CAT_COV) next
    f <- factor(as.character(x))
    if (nlevels(f) < 2) { d[[v]] <- f; next }
    want <- if(is.null(ref)) ref_wanted(v) else if(!is.null(names(ref))) if(v %in% names(ref)) as.character(ref[[v]]) else "modal" else as.character(ref)[1]
    top  <- if (identical(want, "modal")) mode_level(f) else {
      if (want %in% levels(f)) want else {
        message("ER_SCHEMA_REF_UNKNOWN ", v, ": COV_REF level '", want,
                "' is not in the data - using the most frequent level")
        mode_level(f)
      }
    }
    if (!is.na(top)) {
      if (levels(f)[1] != top) releveled[v] <- levels(f)[1]               # old reference
      f <- stats::relevel(f, ref = top)
    }
    d[[v]] <- f
  }
  list(data = d, releveled = releveled)
}
check_cat_ref <- function(d, vars, fit = NULL) {
  if(!is.null(fit)) d <- d[match(rownames(model.frame(fit)),rownames(d)),,drop=FALSE]
  for (v in intersect(vars, names(d))) {
    rx <- d[[v]]
    if (is.numeric(rx) && length(unique(stats::na.omit(rx))) > 2) next
    cc <- cat_counts(d, v)
    if (!nrow(cc)) next
    rr <- cat_ref_level(d, v, fit)
    if (!is.na(rr) && !identical(as.character(rr), as.character(cc$level[1])))
      message("ER_SCHEMA_REF_NOT_LARGEST ", v, ": model reference '", rr,
              "' is not the most frequent level '", cc$level[1],
              "' - re-check the plot labels for this covariate")
  }
}

derive <- function(d) {
  d[[EXPO2]] <- if(HAVE_EXPO) if(LOGPK) log(num(d[[PK_EXPO]])) else num(d[[PK_EXPO]]) else rep(NA_real_,nrow(d))
  d$LCavg_EOT <- if(HAVE_EOT) if(LOGPK) log(num(d[[PK_EXPO_EOT]])) else num(d[[PK_EXPO_EOT]]) else rep(NA_real_,nrow(d))
  # Derived covariates
  for (v in names(COV_DERIVE)) {
    val <- tryCatch(COV_DERIVE[[v]](d), error = function(e) e)
    if (inherits(val, "error")) {
      message("ER_SCHEMA_DERIVE_SKIP ", v, ": ", conditionMessage(val)); next
    }
    if (length(val) != nrow(d)) {
      message("ER_SCHEMA_DERIVE_SKIP ", v, ": length ", length(val), " != ", nrow(d)); next
    }
    d[[v]] <- val
  }
  if (!"WGTRL" %in% names(d)) d$WGTRL <- num(d[["WC"]])
  set_cat_ref(d, CAT_COV)$data                           # reference from COV_REF
}
EXPO2   <- if (LOGPK) paste0("L", PK_EXPO) else PK_EXPO
pop_eff <- derive(pop_eff)
pop_saf <- derive(pop_saf)

cat("subjects read:", n_all, "| PK:", n_pk, "| efficacy:", n_eff, "| safety:", n_saf, "\n")
cat("exposure:", PK_EXPO, "| endpoints:", length(EPS), "| regression:", RUN_REGRESSION, "\n")

```{r helper-functions}

cut_exposure <- function(dat, var, n_quantile = N_QUANTILE) {
  x <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(dat[[var]]))
  if (all(is.na(x))) stop("ER_SCHEMA_CUT: exposure column '", var, "' is empty.")
  brks <- unique(as.numeric(quantile(x, probs = seq(0, 1, 1 / n_quantile), na.rm = TRUE)))
  if (length(brks) < 3)
    stop("ER_SCHEMA_EXPO_TIES: only ", length(brks), " distinct cut point(s) in '",
         var, "' — too tied for quantile groups.")
  k <- length(brks) - 1
  prefix <- switch(as.character(k), "2" = "H", "3" = "T", "Q")
  labs <- paste0(prefix, seq_len(k), " [", er_format_coef(brks[-length(brks)]),
                 "-", er_format_coef(brks[-1]), "]")
  dat[[var]] <- cut(x, breaks = brks, include.lowest = TRUE, labels = labs)
  dat
}

plot.rate <- function(dat, yvar, yvar.lab, xvar = PK_EXPO,
                      xlab = paste0(PK_EXPO_LAB, " Quartiles"),
                      n_quantile = N_QUANTILE, col = NULL, dose_text = TRUE) {
  dat <- cut_exposure(dat, xvar, n_quantile)
  mat    <- tapply(dat[[yvar]], dat[[xvar]], mean, na.rm = TRUE) * 100
  mat.d  <- table(dat[[xvar]])
  mat.n  <- tapply(dat[[yvar]], dat[[xvar]], sum, na.rm = TRUE)
  mat.sd <- sqrt(mat * (100 - mat) / 100 / 100 / mat.d) * 100
  n.x <- length(levels(dat[[xvar]])) + 1
  if (is.null(col)) col <- c("#4E79A7", "#F28E2B", "#59A14F", "#E15759", "#B07AA1", "#76B7B2")
  dose_lines <- character()
  if(dose_text && DOSE_VAR %in% names(dat) && length(unique(na.omit(dat[[DOSE_VAR]])))>1) {
    doses <- sort(unique(na.omit(dat[[DOSE_VAR]])))
    labels <- vapply(doses,function(d) {
      v <- dat[[yvar]][dat[[DOSE_VAR]]==d & !is.na(dat[[yvar]])]
      sprintf("%s: %.1f%% (%d/%d)",d,100*mean(v),sum(v),length(v))
    },"")
    dose_lines <- unlist(lapply(labels,function(label)
      strwrap(paste0(REG_LABEL,": ",label),width=85)),use.names=FALSE)
  }
  old_par <- par(no.readonly=TRUE)
  on.exit(par(old_par),add=TRUE)
  par(mar=c(5.1,4.1,max(1.5,length(dose_lines)+2),2.1),xpd=FALSE)
  ymax <- max(110,mat+mat.sd+15,na.rm=TRUE)
  plot(c(0.45,n.x-0.45),c(0,ymax),type="n",axes=FALSE,
       ylab=paste0(yvar.lab," (%)"),xlab=xlab,cex.lab=1.3)
  axis(1,seq(1,n.x-1,1),lab=levels(dat[[xvar]]),cex.axis=1)
  axis(2,at=seq(0,100,20))
  delta <- 0.38
  for(i in seq_len(n.x-1)) {
    polygon(c(i-delta,i+delta,i+delta,i-delta),
            c(0,0,mat[i],mat[i]),density=-10,col=col[i],border=col[i])
    segments(x0=i,y0=mat[i],x1=i,y1=mat[i]+mat.sd[i],col=col[i])
    segments(x0=i-delta+.2,x1=i+delta-.2,y0=mat[i]+mat.sd[i],col=col[i])
    text(i,mat[i]+mat.sd[i]+12,paste0(round(mat[i],1),"%"),cex=1)
    text(i,mat[i]+mat.sd[i]+5,paste0("(",mat.n[i],"/",mat.d[i],")"),cex=1)
  }
  if(length(dose_lines)) mtext(dose_lines,side=3,
    line=.8+rev(seq_along(dose_lines)-1),adj=0,cex=.85,xpd=NA)
}

plot.logi <- function(dat, expo_par = PK_EXPO, x_lab = PK_EXPO_LAB,
                      ev_var = "ORR", y_lab = "ORR (%)", reg = NA,
                      reg_lab = "Dose (mg QD)", n_quantile = N_QUANTILE,
                      logpk = LOGPK, curve = NULL) {
  dat1 <- dat %>% mutate(EXPO = .data[[expo_par]], Res = .data[[ev_var]])
  bin_df <- dat1 %>%
    mutate(bin = ntile(EXPO, n_quantile)) %>%
    group_by(bin) %>%
    summarise(expo_mid = median(EXPO, na.rm = TRUE),
              rate = mean(Res, na.rm = TRUE),
              N_R = sum(Res, na.rm = TRUE), N = dplyr::n(),
              Lower = binom.test(N_R, N)$conf.int[1],
              Upper = binom.test(N_R, N)$conf.int[2],
              .groups = "drop")
  model_exposure <- if(logpk) log(dat1$EXPO) else dat1$EXPO
  if(is.null(curve)) {
    model_data <- transform(dat1,EXPO_FIT=model_exposure)
    curve <- tryCatch(pmx_regression_checked(glm(Res~EXPO_FIT,data=model_data,family=binomial)),
      error=function(e) {message("ER_LOGISTIC_CURVE_UNAVAILABLE: ",conditionMessage(e));NULL})
  }
  p_top <- ggplot(dat1, aes(x = EXPO, y = Res)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7, shape = 1) +
    geom_point(data = bin_df, aes(x = expo_mid, y = rate), size = 2, col = "red", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_errorbar(data = bin_df, aes(x = expo_mid, ymin = Lower, ymax = Upper), inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1)) +
    labs(x = x_lab, y = y_lab) + theme_bw()
  if(!is.null(curve)) {
    fit_x <- seq(min(model_exposure),max(model_exposure),length.out=100)
    grid <- setNames(data.frame(fit_x),attr(terms(curve),"term.labels"))
    pred <- predict(curve,newdata=grid,type="link",se.fit=TRUE)
    grid$EXPO <- if(logpk) exp(fit_x) else fit_x
    grid$rate <- plogis(pred$fit);grid$lower <- plogis(pred$fit-qnorm(.975)*pred$se.fit);grid$upper <- plogis(pred$fit+qnorm(.975)*pred$se.fit)
    p_top <- p_top + geom_ribbon(data=grid,aes(x=EXPO,ymin=lower,ymax=upper),inherit.aes=FALSE,alpha=.15) +
      geom_line(data=grid,aes(x=EXPO,y=rate),inherit.aes=FALSE,colour="red")
  } else p_top <- p_top + labs(caption="Logistic curve unavailable: convergence or estimability checks failed; observed summaries are retained.")
  if (logpk) p_top <- p_top + scale_x_log10(labels = scales::label_number())

  if (is.na(reg)[1]) return(p_top)

  p_bottom <- ggplot(dat1 %>% mutate(Regf = droplevels(as.factor(.data[[reg]]))),
                     aes(x = Regf, y = EXPO)) +
    geom_boxplot() + coord_flip() +
    labs(x = reg_lab, y = x_lab) +
    theme_bw()
  if (logpk) p_bottom <- p_bottom + scale_y_log10(labels = scales::label_number())

  plot_grid(p_top + theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_blank(),
                          axis.ticks.x = element_blank()),
            p_bottom, align = "v", ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(2.4, 1))
}

km.plot <- function(dat, pkvar = PK_EXPO_EOT, timevar = "DORMIN", evvar = "DOREVT",
                    xlab = "Time (Months)", ylab = NULL,
                    direction = c("down", "up"), legendx = 0.17, legedy = 0.2,
                    legend = pkvar, n_quantile = N_QUANTILE,
                    risk.table = TRUE, break.x.by = 5) {
  direction <- match.arg(direction)
  if (is.null(ylab))
    ylab <- if (direction == "down") "Survival probability"
            else "Cumulative event probability"
  dat <- cut_exposure(dat, pkvar, n_quantile)
  fml <- as.formula(paste0("Surv(time=", timevar, ", event=", evvar, ") ~", pkvar))
  KM_dat <- survfit(fml, data = dat)
  KM_dat$call$formula <- fml
  ggsurvplot(KM_dat, data = dat, fun = if (direction == "up") "event" else NULL,
             risk.table = risk.table, break.x.by = break.x.by,
             xlab = xlab, ylab = ylab,
             legend.labs = levels(dat[[pkvar]]), legend.title = legend,
             legend = c(legendx, legedy),
             tables.height = 0.2, tables.theme = theme_cleantable(),
             risk.table.y.text = FALSE, risk.table.pos = "out")
}

est_table <- function(fit, se_col = "Std. Error") {
  est <- coef(fit); se <- summary(fit)$coefficients[, se_col]
  data.frame(EST = est, SE = se, CI_LB = est - 1.96 * se, CI_UB = est + 1.96 * se) %>%
    mutate(p = 2 * pnorm(-abs(EST / SE)),
           BIC = BIC(fit))
}

glm_fitter <- function(df, response) {
  f <- function(rhs, data = df) {
    form <- as.formula(paste(response,"~",rhs))
    vars <- all.vars(form)
    d <- data[complete.cases(data[,vars,drop=FALSE]),,drop=FALSE]
    d <- set_cat_ref(d,intersect(CAT_COV,vars))$data
    pmx_regression_checked(glm(form,data=d,family=binomial,na.action=na.fail))
  }
  attr(f, "se_col") <- "Std. Error"
  f
}
cox_fitter <- function(df, timevar, evvar) {
  f <- function(rhs) {
    form <- as.formula(paste0("Surv(",timevar,",",evvar,") ~ ",rhs))
    vars <- all.vars(form); d <- df[complete.cases(df[,vars,drop=FALSE]),,drop=FALSE]
    d <- set_cat_ref(d,intersect(CAT_COV,vars))$data
    pmx_regression_checked(coxph(form,data=d,model=TRUE))
  }
  attr(f, "se_col") <- "se(coef)"
  f
}

all_cov_of <- function(df) {
  cand <- setdiff(intersect(ALL_COV, names(df)), c(PK_EXPO, EXPO2))
  keep <- vapply(cand, function(v) {
    x <- df[[v]]; x <- x[!is.na(x)]
    length(x) >= 3 && length(unique(x)) >= 2
  }, logical(1))
  dropped <- cand[!keep]
  if (length(dropped)) message("ER_SCHEMA_COV_DROP ", paste(dropped, collapse = ", "))
  cand[keep]
}

er_method_text <- function() {
  exposure <- if(LOGPK) "log(Exposure_i)" else "Exposure_i"
  c("Graphical analyses were conducted to explore the relationships between PK exposure metrics and clinical endpoints.",
    "Logistic regression was used for binary endpoints, and Cox proportional hazards model was applied for time-to-event endpoints.",
    "Logistic regression model is shown as follows:",
    paste0("logit(P_i) = β0 + β1 × ",exposure," + β2 × COV_i"),
    "P_i: Individual probability of event for patient i",
    "β0: Intercept parameter representing the baseline log-odds of event",
    paste0("β1: Slope parameter describing the effect of ",exposure," on the log-odds of event"),
    "β2: Slope parameter describing the effect of covariate on the log-odds of event",
    "COV_i: Covariate value for patient i",
    "Cox proportional hazards model is shown as follows:",
    paste0("h(t) = h0(t) × exp(β1 × ",exposure," + β2 × COV_i)"),
    "h(t): The hazard function at time t",
    "h0(t): The baseline hazard function at time t",
    paste0("β1: Slope parameter describing the effect of ",exposure," on hazard"),
    "β2: Slope parameter describing the effect of covariate on hazard",
    "COV_i: Covariate value for patient i",
    "Covariate terms are omitted from the exposure-only base model. For multiple covariates, β2 × COV_i represents the corresponding sum of coefficient-covariate products.")
}
er_safety_method <- function() {
  if(!isTRUE(RUN_SAFETY)) return(character())
  c("Safety exposure curves show exploratory unadjusted logistic fits.",
    if(isTRUE(RUN_REGRESSION) && length(SAFETY_MODEL_ENDPOINTS))
      "Prespecified binary safety endpoints in the safety population were assessed using exposure-only models and stepwise covariate selection where estimable.")
}
er_covariate_method <- function() {
  if (!isTRUE(RUN_REGRESSION)) return("Regression and covariate screening were disabled.")
  candidates <- ALL_COV
  labels <- COV_LABEL[candidates]
  labels[is.na(labels)] <- candidates[is.na(labels)]
  c(if(length(candidates)) paste0("Configured screening candidates were ", paste(labels, collapse=", "), ".")
    else "The analysis specified no covariate screening candidates.",
    if(length(candidates)) "Each evaluable candidate was compared with its exposure-only model on matching records. BIC guided selection.",
    if(length(candidates) && !is.na(SCREEN_P)) paste0("Screening additionally required p < ",SCREEN_P,"."),
    if(isTRUE(RUN_SAFETY) && length(SAFETY_MODEL_ENDPOINTS))
      paste0("For designated binary safety endpoints, exposure was retained during forward addition and backward elimination. Nested models were compared on matching records using BIC",
        if(!is.na(SCREEN_P)) " and a likelihood-ratio test" else "", "."))
}

screen_model <- function(df, fitter, expo = EXPO2, covariates = all_cov_of(df)) {
  se_col <- attr(fitter, "se_col")
  base_fit <- fitter(expo)
  if(inherits(base_fit,"glm") && !isTRUE(base_fit$converged)) stop("Base regression did not converge")
  if(any(!is.finite(coef(base_fit)))) stop("Base regression has nonfinite/aliased coefficients")
  base_tab <- est_table(base_fit, se_col)
  failed <- character()
  rows <- lapply(covariates, function(v) {
    f <- tryCatch(fitter(paste(expo, "+", v)), error = function(e) {
      message("ER_CANDIDATE_UNUSABLE ",v,": ",conditionMessage(e));failed <<- c(failed,v);NULL })
    if(!is.null(f) && inherits(f,"glm") && !isTRUE(f$converged)) f <- NULL
    if(!is.null(f) && any(!is.finite(coef(f)))) f <- NULL
    if (is.null(f)) {failed <<- union(failed,v);return(NULL)}
    e <- tryCatch(est_table(f, se_col), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(e) || nrow(e) <= nrow(base_tab)) {failed <<- union(failed,v);return(NULL)}
    e <- tail(e, nrow(e) - nrow(base_tab))
    mf <- model.frame(f)
    same_base <- tryCatch(pmx_regression_checked(update(f,formula=as.formula(paste(deparse(formula(f)[[2]]),"~",expo)),data=df[match(rownames(mf),rownames(df)),,drop=FALSE])),error=function(e) NULL)
    if(is.null(same_base) || nrow(model.frame(same_base))!=nrow(mf)) {failed <<- union(failed,v);return(NULL)}
    e$REFERENCE_BIC <- BIC(same_base)
    e$N_ANALYSED <- nrow(mf)
    e$covariate <- v
    e$Comparison <- if(v %in% CAT_COV) vapply(rownames(e),function(term) cat_effect_label(df,v,cat_level_of_term(df,v,term),fit=f),"") else "continuous"
    e
  })
  rows <- rows[!vapply(rows, is.null, logical(1))]
  if (!length(rows)) {
    return(list(base = base_fit, univ = NULL, full = base_fit, retained = character(0),failed=unique(failed),assessment=if(length(failed)) "partial" else "complete"))
  }
  univ <- do.call(rbind, rows)
  univ$BIC <- univ$BIC
  univ <- univ %>%
    mutate(DELTA_BIC = round(BIC - REFERENCE_BIC, 1),
           Retained = ifelse(BIC < REFERENCE_BIC &
                               (is.na(SCREEN_P) | p < SCREEN_P), "Yes", "No")) %>%
    # Order by selection and change in BIC
    arrange(desc(Retained == "Yes"), DELTA_BIC, BIC, covariate)
  kept <- univ$covariate[univ$Retained == "Yes"]
  kept <- unique(kept)
  full_fit <- if(length(kept)) fitter(paste(c(expo, kept), collapse = " + ")) else base_fit
  if(inherits(full_fit,"glm") && !isTRUE(full_fit$converged)) stop("Final regression did not converge")
  if(any(!is.finite(coef(full_fit)))) stop("Final regression has nonfinite/aliased coefficients")
  list(base = base_fit, univ = univ, full = full_fit, retained = kept,failed=unique(failed),assessment=if(length(failed)) "partial" else "complete")
}

er_safety_scm <- function(df, fitter, expo = EXPO2, covariates = all_cov_of(df)) {
  fit <- function(terms, data=df) fitter(paste(c(expo,terms),collapse=" + "),data)
  base <- fit(character())
  final <- base
  retained <- failed <- character()
  trials <- list()

  compare <- function(v, direction) {
    adding <- direction == "Forward"
    reduced_terms <- if(adding) retained else setdiff(retained,v)
    full_terms <- if(adding) c(retained,v) else retained
    sample <- df[match(rownames(model.frame(final)),rownames(df)),,drop=FALSE]
    if(adding) sample <- sample[!is.na(sample[[v]]),,drop=FALSE]
    candidate <- reference <- NULL
    error <- tryCatch({
      if(min(table(factor(model.response(model.frame(final)),levels=0:1))) < 3L)
        stop("Insufficient events or non-events")
      if(adding) {
        reference <- if(nrow(sample)==nobs(final)) final else fit(reduced_terms,sample)
        candidate <- fit(full_terms,sample)
      } else {
        reference <- final
        candidate <- fit(reduced_terms,sample)
      }
      if(!identical(rownames(model.frame(candidate)),rownames(model.frame(reference))))
        stop("Candidate and reference model samples differ")
      y <- model.response(model.frame(candidate))
      if(min(table(factor(y,levels=0:1))) < 3L) stop("Insufficient events or non-events")
      ""
    },error=function(e) conditionMessage(e))
    if(nzchar(error)) failed <<- union(failed,v)
    bic <- reference_bic <- p <- NA_real_
    if(!nzchar(error)) {
      bic <- BIC(candidate)
      reference_bic <- BIC(reference)
      small <- if(adding) reference else candidate
      large <- if(adding) candidate else reference
      p <- as.numeric(anova(small,large,test="LRT")[2,"Pr(>Chi)"])
    }
    list(fit=candidate,row=data.frame(Step=length(trials)+1L,Direction=direction,
      Covariate=v,N=nrow(sample),BIC=bic,Reference_BIC=reference_bic,Delta_BIC=bic-reference_bic,
      P=p,Selected=FALSE,Issue=error))
  }

  for(direction in c("Forward","Backward")) repeat {
    candidates <- if(direction=="Forward") setdiff(covariates,retained) else retained
    if(!length(candidates)) break
    results <- lapply(candidates,compare,direction=direction)
    rows <- do.call(rbind,lapply(results,function(x) x$row))
    pass <- !is.na(rows$Delta_BIC) & rows$Delta_BIC < 0
    if(!is.na(SCREEN_P)) {
      p_pass <- if(direction=="Forward") rows$P < SCREEN_P else rows$P >= SCREEN_P
      pass <- pass & !is.na(rows$P) & p_pass
    }
    winner <- which(pass)[which.min(rows$Delta_BIC[pass])]
    if(length(winner)) rows$Selected[winner] <- TRUE
    trials[[length(trials)+1L]] <- rows
    if(!length(winner)) break
    v <- rows$Covariate[winner]
    if(direction=="Forward") {
      retained <- c(retained,v)
      final <- results[[winner]]$fit
    } else {
      retained <- setdiff(retained,v)
      candidate <- results[[winner]]$fit
      refreshed <- tryCatch(fit(retained),error=function(e) NULL)
      final <- if(is.null(refreshed)) candidate else refreshed
    }
  }
  list(base=base,full=final,univ=NULL,scm=do.call(rbind,trials),retained=retained,
       failed=failed,assessment=if(length(failed)) "partial" else "complete")
}

er_scm_table <- function(rows) {
  if(is.null(rows)) return(NULL)
  data.frame(Step=rows$Step, Direction=rows$Direction,
    Covariate=vapply(rows$Covariate,cov_lab,""), N=rows$N,
    BIC=er_format_coef(rows$BIC), "Reference BIC"=er_format_coef(rows$Reference_BIC),
    "Delta BIC"=er_format_coef(rows$Delta_BIC), "LRT p"=er_format_coef(rows$P,3),
    Selected=ifelse(rows$Selected,"Yes","No"), Issue=rows$Issue,check.names=FALSE)
}

er_format_coef <- function(x,digits=2) {
  vapply(x,function(value) {
    if(!is.finite(value)) return("NE")
    a <- abs(value)
    if(a==0) return("0")
    if(a<0.0001) return(sub("e([+-])0+","e\\1",formatC(value,digits=digits-1,format="e")))
    places <- if(a>=1) digits else max(digits,digits-1-floor(log10(a)))
    text <- formatC(value,digits=places,format="f")
    text <- sub("0+$","",text);sub("\\.$","",text)
  },"",USE.NAMES=FALSE)
}
er_full_equals_base <- function(scr) {
  !is.null(scr) && !length(scr$retained) &&
    identical(deparse(formula(scr$base)),deparse(formula(scr$full))) &&
    identical(rownames(model.frame(scr$base)),rownames(model.frame(scr$full))) &&
    isTRUE(all.equal(coef(scr$base),coef(scr$full),tolerance=1e-12))
}
er_result_placeholder <- function(ep,kind="graphical") paste0("[",
  if(kind=="graphical") "Exposure-response trend" else "Regression effects",
  " for ",ep$label,": interpretation pending.]")
er_assessment_text <- function(scr) if(length(scr$failed)) paste0("Covariate assessment was incomplete: ",paste(scr$failed,collapse=", ")," could not be evaluated; failure is not evidence of no effect.") else character()
er_same_model_text <- function(scr) {
  if(length(scr$failed)) return(paste(er_assessment_text(scr),"The reported full model has the base structure."))
  has_screening <- nrow(scr$univ %||% scr$scm %||% data.frame()) > 0L
  if(!has_screening)
    "No evaluable covariate-screening results were available. The full model is the same as the base model."
  else "No covariates met the configured selection criteria. The full model is the same as the base model."
}
er_term_label <- function(x) {
  out <- as.character(x)
  out[out==EXPO2] <- if(LOGPK) paste0("Log(",PK_EXPO,")") else PK_EXPO
  out
}
er_comparison_label <- function(x) sub("\\s*\\(N\\s*=.*\\)\\s*$","",x,perl=TRUE)

er_kable <- function(d,...) {
  prefixes <- attr(d,"bold_labels")
  shown <- d
  shown[] <- lapply(shown,function(x) { x <- as.character(x);x[is.na(x)] <- "";htmltools::htmlEscape(x) })
  label_column <- intersect(c("Covariate","Parameter"),names(shown))[1]
  if(!is.na(label_column)) {
    indented <- which(startsWith(as.character(d[[label_column]]),"\u00a0"))
    for(i in indented) shown[[label_column]][i] <- paste0('<span data-indent="1" style="padding-left:1ch">',
      htmltools::htmlEscape(sub("^\u00a0","",as.character(d[[label_column]][i]))),'</span>')
    if(length(prefixes)) for(i in seq_len(nrow(shown))) {
      prefix <- prefixes[i]
      if(!is.na(prefix) && nzchar(prefix) && startsWith(as.character(d[[label_column]][i]),prefix)) {
        rest <- substring(as.character(d[[label_column]][i]),nchar(prefix)+1)
        shown[[label_column]][i] <- paste0("<strong>",htmltools::htmlEscape(prefix),"</strong>",htmltools::htmlEscape(rest))
      }
    }
  }
  knitr::kable(shown,format="html",escape=FALSE,row.names=FALSE,...)
}

er_covariate_label <- function(v,var_meta,with_unit=FALSE) {
  i <- match(v,var_meta$orig_var)
  label <- as.character(var_meta$display[i])
  if(is.na(label) || !nzchar(label)) label <- gsub("_"," ",v)
  unit <- as.character(var_meta$unit[i])
  paste0(label,if(with_unit && !is.na(unit) && nzchar(unit)) paste0(" (",unit,")") else "")
}

er_model_term_labels <- function(fit,var_meta=ep_var_meta()) {
  terms <- names(coef(fit));labels <- er_term_label(terms);df <- model.frame(fit)
  candidates <- intersect(unique(c(CON_COV,CAT_COV)),names(df))
  for(i in seq_along(terms)) {
    term <- terms[i]
    if(term %in% c("(Intercept)",EXPO2,PK_EXPO)) next
    hits <- candidates[vapply(candidates,function(v)
      if(v %in% CAT_COV) startsWith(term,v) else identical(term,v),logical(1))]
    if(!length(hits)) next
    variable <- hits[which.max(nchar(hits))]
    categorical <- variable %in% CAT_COV
    labels[i] <- cov_lab(variable)
    if(categorical) labels[i] <- paste(labels[i],
      er_comparison_label(cat_effect_label(df,variable,cat_level_of_term(df,variable,term),fit=fit)),sep="\n")
  }
  setNames(labels,terms)
}

model_out <- function(fit, se_col, effect = c("OR", "HR"), digits = 2) {
  effect <- match.arg(effect)
  est <- coef(fit); se <- summary(fit)$coefficients[,se_col]
  format_coef <- function(x) er_format_coef(x,digits)
  lb <- est-qnorm(0.975)*se; ub <- est+qnorm(0.975)*se
  tab <- data.frame(Parameter=unname(er_model_term_labels(fit)),Estimate=format_coef(est),
    `SE (RSE%)`=paste0(format_coef(se)," (",round(100*se/abs(est),1),")"),
    `95% CI`=paste0(format_coef(lb)," to ",format_coef(ub)),
    `P value`=format.pval(2*pnorm(-abs(est/se)),digits=2,eps=0.001),
    check.names=FALSE,row.names=NULL)
  df <- model.frame(fit);variables <- intersect(CAT_COV,names(df))
  rows <- list();bold_labels <- character();seen <- character()
  for(i in seq_len(nrow(tab))) {
    term <- names(est)[i]
    matches <- variables[vapply(variables,function(v) startsWith(term,v),TRUE)]
    variable <- if(length(matches) && !term %in% c(EXPO2,PK_EXPO)) matches[which.max(nchar(matches))] else ""
    row <- tab[i,,drop=FALSE]
    if(nzchar(variable)) {
      label <- cov_lab(variable)
      if(!variable %in% seen) {
        header <- row;header[] <- "";header$Parameter <- label
        rows[[length(rows)+1L]] <- header;bold_labels <- c(bold_labels,label);seen <- c(seen,variable)
      }
      row$Parameter <- paste0("\u00a0",er_comparison_label(
        cat_effect_label(df,variable,cat_level_of_term(df,variable,term),fit=fit)))
      bold_labels <- c(bold_labels,"")
    } else bold_labels <- c(bold_labels,if(term %in% CON_COV) cov_lab(term) else "")
    rows[[length(rows)+1L]] <- row
  }
  out <- do.call(rbind,rows);rownames(out) <- NULL;attr(out,"bold_labels") <- bold_labels;out
}

covariate_summary <- function(screened, kind = c("Logistic", "Cox"), endpoint) {
  kind <- match.arg(kind)
  u <- screened$univ
  if (is.null(u) || !nrow(u)) return(NULL)
  out <- data.frame(
    Endpoint  = endpoint,
    Model     = kind,
    Covariate = ifelse(u$Comparison=="continuous",u$covariate,paste(u$covariate,u$Comparison,sep="\n")),
    Estimate  = er_format_coef(u$EST),
    SE        = er_format_coef(u$SE),
    `95% CI`  = paste0(er_format_coef(u$CI_LB), " to ", er_format_coef(u$CI_UB)),
    `P value` = format.pval(u$p, digits = 2, eps = 0.001),
    `Effect (95% CI)` = paste0(round(exp(u$EST), 2), " (", round(exp(u$CI_LB), 2),
                               " - ", round(exp(u$CI_UB), 2), ")"),
    `Delta BIC` = u$DELTA_BIC,
    Retained    = u$Retained,
    check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  out$`Effect type` <- if (kind == "Logistic") "Odds ratio" else "Hazard ratio"
  out[, c("Endpoint", "Model", "Covariate", "Estimate", "SE", "95% CI", "P value",
          "Effect type", "Effect (95% CI)", "Delta BIC", "Retained")]
}

coveff_table <- function(fit,df,se_col,effect=c("OR","HR"),pk_expo=PK_EXPO,
                         logpk=LOGPK,var_meta) {
  effect <- match.arg(effect);ce <- est_table(fit,se_col)
  ce <- ce[rownames(ce)!="(Intercept)",,drop=FALSE]
  candidates <- unique(c(con_cov_glob,cat_cov_glob))
  label_of <- function(v) er_covariate_label(v,var_meta)
  rows <- list()
  append_effect <- function(term,label,estimate,se,delta,type) {
    logeff <- estimate*delta;logse <- abs(delta)*se
    values <- exp(logeff+c(0,-1,1)*qnorm(.975)*logse)
    if(any(!is.finite(values)) || any(values<=0)) return(invisible(NULL))
    rows[[length(rows)+1L]] <<- data.frame(rowname=term,label=label,Eff=values[1],
      Eff_LB=values[2],Eff_UB=values[3],
      eff_text=paste0(er_format_coef(values[1])," (",er_format_coef(values[2])," - ",er_format_coef(values[3]),")"),
      var_type=type,stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
  }
  for(i in seq_len(nrow(ce))) {
    term <- rownames(ce)[i]
    if(!is.finite(ce$EST[i]) || !is.finite(ce$SE[i])) next
    exposure <- term %in% c(EXPO2,pk_expo)
    hits <- candidates[startsWith(term,candidates)]
    variable <- if(exposure) pk_expo else if(length(hits)) hits[which.max(nchar(hits))] else NA_character_
    if(is.na(variable) || !variable %in% names(df)) stop("Cannot map fitted forest term: ",term)
    categorical <- !exposure && variable %in% cat_cov_glob
    if(categorical) {
      level <- cat_level_of_term(df,variable,term)
      check_cat_ref(df,variable,fit=fit)
      label <- paste(label_of(variable),cat_effect_label(df,variable,level,fit=fit),sep="\n")
      append_effect(term,label,ce$EST[i],ce$SE[i],1,"categorical")
    } else {
      x <- num(df[[variable]]); x <- x[is.finite(x)]
      if(length(x)<3L || (exposure && logpk && any(x<=0))) next
      quantiles <- as.numeric(quantile(x,c(.05,.5,.95),na.rm=TRUE))
      title <- er_covariate_label(variable,var_meta,with_unit=TRUE)
      for(j in c(1L,3L)) {
        delta <- if(exposure && logpk) log(quantiles[j])-log(quantiles[2]) else quantiles[j]-quantiles[2]
        label <- paste0(title,"\n",if(j==1L) "P05" else "P95"," = ",er_format_coef(quantiles[j]),
                        " : Median = ",er_format_coef(quantiles[2]))
        append_effect(term,label,ce$EST[i],ce$SE[i],delta,"continuous")
      }
    }
  }
  if(!length(rows)) return(data.frame(rowname=character(),label=character(),Eff=numeric(),Eff_LB=numeric(),
    Eff_UB=numeric(),eff_text=character(),var_type=character(),stringsAsFactors=FALSE))
  plot_df <- do.call(rbind,rows);attr(plot_df,"effect") <- effect;plot_df
}

forest_plot <- function(plot_df, xlab) {
  plot_df <- as.data.frame(plot_df, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  plot_df <- plot_df[is.finite(plot_df$Eff) & is.finite(plot_df$Eff_LB) &
                     is.finite(plot_df$Eff_UB), , drop = FALSE]
  if (!nrow(plot_df))
    return(ggplot() + theme_void())
  if (any(is.na(plot_df$label) | !nzchar(as.character(plot_df$label))))
    plot_df$label <- ifelse(is.na(plot_df$label) | !nzchar(as.character(plot_df$label)),
                            as.character(plot_df$rowname), as.character(plot_df$label))
  plot_df$yid <- factor(seq_len(nrow(plot_df)),
                        levels = seq_len(nrow(plot_df))[order(plot_df$var_type)])
  rng  <- range(c(plot_df$Eff_LB, plot_df$Eff_UB, 1), na.rm = TRUE)
  xlim <- c(max(rng[1] / 10^0.25, 1e-3), rng[2] * 10^0.25)
  longest_line <- function(x) {
    x <- as.character(x); x <- x[!is.na(x)]
    if (!length(x)) return(0)
    max(vapply(strsplit(x, "\n", fixed = TRUE),
               function(s) max(nchar(s), 0), numeric(1)))
  }
  lab_pt <- longest_line(plot_df$label) * 5.7 + 14
  eff_pt <- longest_line(plot_df$eff_text) * 5.7 + 14
  ggplot(plot_df, aes(y = yid)) +
    geom_segment(aes(x = Eff_LB, xend = Eff_UB, yend = yid),
                 linewidth = 0.6, color = "grey30") +
    geom_point(aes(x = Eff, shape = var_type, color = var_type), size = 3, stroke = 1.1) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_text(aes(x = xlim[1], label = label), hjust = 1, size = 4, lineheight = 0.95) +
    geom_text(aes(x = xlim[2], label = eff_text), hjust = 0, size = 4) +
    scale_x_log10(name = xlab, labels = scales::label_number()) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(categorical = 1, continuous = 15), guide = "none") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(categorical = "black", continuous = "red"), guide = "none") +
    labs(y = NULL) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = xlim, clip = "off") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    theme(panel.grid       = element_blank(),
          panel.border     = element_blank(),
          axis.line.x      = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.6),
          axis.ticks.x     = element_line(color = "black"),
          axis.text.x      = element_text(size = 10),
          axis.title.x     = element_text(size = 11, margin = margin(t = 8)),
          axis.text.y      = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.y     = element_blank(),
          plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
          panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
          plot.margin      = margin(8, eff_pt, 8, lab_pt))
}
forest_height <- function(plot_df, row_in = 0.42, min_h = 4.5)
  max(min_h, nrow(plot_df) * row_in + 1.8)

con_cov_glob <- CON_COV
cat_cov_glob <- CAT_COV
REG_VAR <- if (DOSE_VAR %in% names(pop_eff) &&
               length(unique(stats::na.omit(pop_eff[[DOSE_VAR]]))) > 1) DOSE_VAR else NA
REG_LAB <- REG_LABEL

# Display names and units
var_meta_all <- function(nms) {
  nms <- unique(as.character(nms))
  nms <- nms[!is.na(nms) & nzchar(nms)]
  data.frame(orig_var = nms,
             display  = ifelse(nms %in% names(COV_LABEL),
                               as.character(COV_LABEL[nms]), nms),
             unit     = ifelse(nms %in% names(COV_UNIT),
                               as.character(COV_UNIT[nms]), NA_character_),
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
VAR_META <- var_meta_all(c(ALL_COV, DOSE_VAR, "DOSE", "DOSEF"))
unit_of_label <- function(l) {
  m <- regmatches(l, regexpr("\\(([^()]*)\\) *$", l))
  if (length(m)) trimws(gsub("[()]", "", m)) else NA_character_
}
ep_var_meta <- function() {
  rbind(as.data.frame(VAR_META, stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
        data.frame(orig_var = c(EXPO2, PK_EXPO),
                   display  = c(er_term_label(EXPO2), PK_EXPO),
                   unit     = rep(unit_of_label(PK_EXPO_LAB), 2),
                   stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
}

ep_data <- function(ep) {
  d <- pop_eff
  if (identical(ep$sub, "responders")) {
    rv <- pick(names(d), c("ORR", "RESPONSE", "OR"))
    if (!is.null(rv)) { r <- as01(d[[rv]]); d <- d[!is.na(r) & r == 1, , drop = FALSE] }
  }
  d
}

ep_caps <- function(ep) {
  binary <- ep$kind=="binary"
  model <- if(binary) "logistic regression" else "Cox regression"
  list(method=if(binary) "Logistic" else "Cox",
       xlab=if(binary) "Odds Ratio" else "Hazard Ratio",effect=if(binary) "OR" else "HR",
       base=sprintf("Parameter estimates of %s %s base model",ep$label,model),
       univ=sprintf("%s for %s %s",
        if(isTRUE(ep$scm)) "Stepwise covariate model search" else "Univariable covariate screening",
        ep$label,model),
       full=sprintf("Parameter estimates of %s %s full model",ep$label,model),
       forest=sprintf("Covariate effect plot of %s %s full model",ep$label,model),
       median=if(binary) NULL else sprintf("Median %s and 95%% CI by exposure quartile",ep$label))
}

ep_fit <- function(ep, d = ep_data(ep)) {
  if (ep$kind == "binary") {
    r <- as01(d[[ep$col]]); d <- d[!is.na(r), , drop = FALSE]
    d[[ep$col]] <- as01(d[[ep$col]])
    out <- list(ep = ep, data = d, fitter = glm_fitter(d, ep$col),
                se_col = "Std. Error", effect = "OR", method = "Logistic",
                n_total = nrow(d), n_events = sum(d[[ep$col]] == 1, na.rm = TRUE))
  } else {
    tm <- num(d[[ep$timevar]]); ev <- as_event(d[[ep$evvar]], ep$evvar)
    d  <- d[is.finite(tm) & !is.na(ev), , drop = FALSE]
    d[[ep$timevar]] <- num(d[[ep$timevar]])
    d[[ep$evvar]]   <- as_event(d[[ep$evvar]], ep$evvar)
    out <- list(ep = ep, data = d, fitter = cox_fitter(d, ep$timevar, ep$evvar),
                se_col = "se(coef)", effect = "HR", method = "Cox",
                n_total = nrow(d), n_events = sum(d[[ep$evvar]] == 1, na.rm = TRUE))
  }
  if (!isTRUE(RUN_REGRESSION)) return(out)
  if (nrow(out$data) < 10 || out$n_events < 3 ||
      (ep$kind == "binary" && nrow(out$data)-out$n_events < 3)) {
    out$regression_error <- "Insufficient evaluable patients, events or non-events"
    return(out)
  }
  search <- if(isTRUE(ep$scm)) er_safety_scm else screen_model
  out$scr <- tryCatch(search(out$data, out$fitter), error = function(e) {
    out$regression_error <<- conditionMessage(e);message("ER_SCHEMA_SCREEN_FAIL ", ep$label, ": ", conditionMessage(e)); NULL })
  out
}

km_median_ci <- function(fit) {
  if(is.null(fit)) return(c(median=NA_real_, lower=NA_real_, upper=NA_real_))
  tab <- summary(fit)$table
  if(!is.null(dim(tab))) tab <- tab[1, ]
  c(median=unname(tab["median"]),lower=unname(tab["0.95LCL"]),upper=unname(tab["0.95UCL"]))
}
median_text <- function(x) if(is.finite(x)) format(round(x,1),nsmall=1) else "NR"
ci_time_text <- function(x) if(is.finite(x)) format(round(x,1),nsmall=1) else "NE"

ep_median_table <- function(ep, d) {
  grp <- if (HAVE_EOT) PK_EXPO_EOT else PK_EXPO
  dq <- cut_exposure(as.data.frame(d),grp)
  tab <- do.call(rbind,lapply(levels(dq[[grp]]),function(g) {
    dd <- dq[dq[[grp]]==g,,drop=FALSE]
    fit <- tryCatch(survfit(Surv(dd[[ep$timevar]],dd[[ep$evvar]])~1,
                            conf.int=0.95,conf.type="log-log"),error=function(e) NULL)
    ci <- km_median_ci(fit)
    data.frame(Exposure=g,N=nrow(dd),Events=sum(dd[[ep$evvar]]==1,na.rm=TRUE),
               Median=if(is.null(fit)) "NE" else median_text(ci["median"]),Lower=ci_time_text(ci["lower"]),
               Upper=ci_time_text(ci["upper"]),check.names=FALSE,row.names=NULL)
  }))
  tab$Median <- paste0(tab$Median," (",tab$Lower,"–",tab$Upper,")")
  tab <- tab[,c("Exposure","N","Events","Median"),drop=FALSE]
  names(tab) <- c("Exposure quartile","N","Events",paste0("Median ",ep$label," (months, 95% CI)"))
  tab
}

ep_univ_table <- function(ep,scr) {
  if(isTRUE(ep$scm)) return(er_scm_table(scr$scm))
  u <- scr$univ
  if(is.null(u) || !nrow(u)) return(NULL)
  rows <- list();bold_labels <- character()
  variables <- unique(u$covariate[order(u$DELTA_BIC,na.last=TRUE)])
  for(variable in variables) {
    group <- u[u$covariate==variable,,drop=FALSE]
    label <- cov_lab(variable);categorical <- variable %in% CAT_COV
    if(categorical) {
      rows[[length(rows)+1L]] <- data.frame(Covariate=label,Estimate="",`95% CI`="",
        BIC=formatC(group$BIC[1],digits=1,format="f"),
        `Delta BIC`=formatC(group$DELTA_BIC[1],digits=1,format="f"),
        Retained=if(variable %in% scr$retained) "Yes" else "No",check.names=FALSE,stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
      bold_labels <- c(bold_labels,label)
    }
    for(i in seq_len(nrow(group))) {
      comparison <- er_comparison_label(group$Comparison[i])
      rows[[length(rows)+1L]] <- data.frame(Covariate=if(categorical) paste0("\u00a0",comparison) else label,
        Estimate=er_format_coef(group$EST[i]),
        `95% CI`=paste(er_format_coef(group$CI_LB[i]),er_format_coef(group$CI_UB[i]),sep=" to "),
        BIC=if(!categorical && i==1L) formatC(group$BIC[i],digits=1,format="f") else "",
        `Delta BIC`=if(!categorical && i==1L) formatC(group$DELTA_BIC[i],digits=1,format="f") else "",
        Retained=if(!categorical && i==1L) if(variable %in% scr$retained) "Yes" else "No" else "",
        check.names=FALSE,stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
      bold_labels <- c(bold_labels,if(categorical) "" else label)
    }
  }
  tab <- do.call(rbind,rows);rownames(tab) <- NULL;attr(tab,"bold_labels") <- bold_labels;tab
}

ep_coveff <- function(ep, fit) {
  rows <- match(rownames(model.frame(fit$scr$full)),rownames(fit$data))
  if(anyNA(rows)) stop("Cannot align the covariate-effect display with the fitted sample")
  coveff_table(fit$scr$full,fit$data[rows,,drop=FALSE],fit$se_col,fit$effect,var_meta=ep_var_meta())
}

ep_chunks <- function(ep,i) {
  caps <- ep_caps(ep);k <- ep$short
  sec <- sprintf("4.2.%d",i)
  sec_plot <- paste0(sec,".1 Graphical analyses for ",ep$label)
  sec_model <- paste0(sec,".2 ",caps$method," regression for ",ep$label)
  km_pk <- if(HAVE_EOT) PK_EXPO_EOT else PK_EXPO
  cap_rate <- paste0("Response rate of ",ep$label," by exposure quartile")
  cap_km <- paste0("Kaplan-Meier plot of ",ep$label," by exposure quartile")
  cap_logistic <- paste0("Logistic regression plot of ",ep$label," by exposure")
  L <- c(paste0("### ",sec," ",ep$label),"",paste0("#### ",sec_plot),"",er_result_placeholder(ep),"")
  if(ep$kind=="binary") { L <- c(L,
    sprintf("```{r ep-%s-rate, fig.width=7.2, fig.height=5.2, fig.cap=%s}",k,deparse(cap_rate)),
    sprintf("plot.rate(EP_FIT[['%s']]$data,'%s','%s',xvar=PK_EXPO,",k,ep$col,ep$label),
    " xlab=paste0(PK_EXPO_LAB,' Quartiles'))","```","")
  } else { L <- c(L,
    sprintf("```{r ep-%s-km, fig.width=7.5, fig.height=6, fig.cap=%s}",k,deparse(cap_km)),
    sprintf("km.plot(EP_FIT[['%s']]$data,pkvar='%s',timevar='%s',evvar='%s',",k,km_pk,ep$timevar,ep$evvar),
    sprintf(" direction='%s',legend='%s',ylab='%s')",ep$direction,km_pk,
      if(ep$direction=="up") "Cumulative event probability" else if(ep$label=="DoR") "Probability of ongoing response" else paste(ep$label,"probability")),
    "```","")
  }
  if(ep$kind=="tte") L <- c(L,sprintf("```{r ep-%s-median, results='asis'}",k),
    "if(!is.null(EP_MED)) print(kable(EP_MED,caption=CAPS$median,table.attr='class=\"table survival-median\"'))",
    "cat('\\nNR: median not reached; NE: confidence limit not estimable.\\n')","```","")
  c(L,ep_model_chunks(ep,sec_model,if(ep$kind=="binary") cap_logistic else NULL))
}

er_model_text <- function(ep) {
  if(is.null(ep$scr)) return(if(length(ep$regression_error))
    paste0("Regression could not be estimated reliably. ",ep$regression_error,"."))
  c(if(er_full_equals_base(ep$scr)) er_same_model_text(ep$scr) else er_assessment_text(ep$scr),
    er_result_placeholder(ep,"regression"))
}

ep_model_chunks <- function(ep,sec_model,cap_logistic=NULL) {
  k <- ep$short
  narrative <- er_model_text(ep)
  if(!length(narrative)) return(character())
  L <- c(paste0("#### ",sec_model),"",as.vector(rbind(narrative,"")))
  if(is.null(ep$scr)) return(L)
  L <- c(L,
    sprintf("```{r ep-%s-base, results='asis'}",k),
    sprintf("print(er_kable(model_out(EP_FIT[['%s']]$scr$base,EP_FIT[['%s']]$se_col,EP_FIT[['%s']]$effect),caption=CAPS$base,table.attr='class=\"table model-parameters\"'))",k,k,k),"```","")
  if(!is.null(cap_logistic)) L <- c(L,
    sprintf("```{r ep-%s-logi, fig.width=7.2, fig.height=6.8, fig.cap=%s}",k,deparse(cap_logistic)),
    sprintf("plot.logi(EP_FIT[['%s']]$data,expo_par=PK_EXPO,x_lab=PK_EXPO_LAB,",k),
    sprintf(" ev_var='%s',y_lab='%s (%%)',reg=REG_VAR,reg_lab=REG_LAB)",ep$col,ep$label),
    "```","")
  L <- c(L,sprintf("```{r ep-%s-univ, results='asis'}",k),
    "if(!is.null(EP_UNIV)) print(er_kable(EP_UNIV,caption=CAPS$univ,table.attr='class=\"table covariate-screen\"'))","```","")
  if(!er_full_equals_base(ep$scr)) L <- c(L,
    sprintf("```{r ep-%s-full, results='asis'}",k),
    sprintf("print(er_kable(model_out(EP_FIT[['%s']]$scr$full,EP_FIT[['%s']]$se_col,EP_FIT[['%s']]$effect),caption=CAPS$full,table.attr='class=\"table model-parameters\"'))",k,k,k),"```","")
  if(isTRUE(ep$has_coveff)) { L <- c(L,
    sprintf("```{r ep-%s-forest, fig.width=8.2, fig.height=EP_H, fig.cap=%s}",k,deparse(ep_caps(ep)$forest)),
    "print(forest_plot(EP_COVEFF,CAPS$xlab))","```","")
  } else L <- c(L,"A covariate-effect plot could not be estimated for this endpoint.","")
  L
}

er_endpoint_report <- function(ep, fit, envir) {
  ep$scr <- fit$scr
  ep$regression_error <- fit$regression_error
  reason <- fit$regression_error %||% "Regression not available"
  cv <- NULL
  if(!is.null(fit$scr)) {
    reason <- "No finite estimable model contrasts"
    cv <- tryCatch(ep_coveff(ep,fit),error=function(e) {reason <<- conditionMessage(e);NULL})
  }
  ep$has_coveff <- !is.null(cv) && nrow(cv)>0L
  ce <- new.env(parent=envir)
  ce$CAPS <- ep_caps(ep)
  ce$EP_MED <- if(ep$kind=="tte") tryCatch(ep_median_table(ep,fit$data),error=function(e) NULL)
  ce$EP_UNIV <- if(!is.null(fit$scr)) ep_univ_table(ep,fit$scr)
  ce$EP_COVEFF <- cv
  ce$EP_H <- if(ep$has_coveff) forest_height(cv) else 4.5
  list(ep=ep,envir=ce,forest_reason=if(ep$has_coveff) "" else reason)
}

## Synopsis

**`r DRUG` in `r INDICATION` — study `r STUDY`.**

```{r synopsis}
ep_summary_rows <- function() {
  if (!length(EPS)) return(data.frame(Analysis = character(0), Result = character(0)))
  do.call(rbind, lapply(EPS, function(ep) {
    d <- ep_data(ep)
    if (ep$kind == "binary") {
      v <- as01(d[[ep$col]]); n1 <- sum(v == 1, na.rm = TRUE); n0 <- sum(!is.na(v))
      val <- paste0(n1, "/", n0, " (", round(100 * n1 / max(n0, 1), 1), "%)")
    } else {
      ev <- as_event(d[[ep$evvar]], ep$evvar)
      val <- paste0(sum(!is.na(ev)), " patients, ", sum(ev == 1, na.rm = TRUE), " events")
    }
    data.frame(Analysis = ep$label, Result = val, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }))
}
ep_rows <- ep_summary_rows()
ep_med <- local({
  endpoints <- Filter(function(ep) ep$kind=="tte",EPS)
  if(!length(endpoints)) return(NULL)
  do.call(rbind,lapply(endpoints,function(ep) {
    d <- ep_data(ep)
    fit <- tryCatch(survfit(Surv(num(d[[ep$timevar]]),as_event(d[[ep$evvar]],ep$evvar))~1,
                            conf.int=0.95,conf.type="log-log"),error=function(e) NULL)
    ci <- km_median_ci(fit)
    data.frame(Analysis=paste0("Median ",ep$label," (95% CI)"),
               Result=paste0(if(is.null(fit)) "NE" else median_text(ci["median"])," months (",ci_time_text(ci["lower"]),
                             " to ",ci_time_text(ci["upper"]),"); NR: not reached; NE: not estimable"),
               stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
  }))
})
if(!is.null(ep_med)) ep_rows <- rbind(ep_rows,ep_med)

saf_txt <- {
  if (exists("SAFETY_DEF") && length(SAFETY_DEF))
    paste0(length(SAFETY_DEF), " pre-specified endpoint(s): ",
           paste(vapply(SAFETY_DEF, function(d) d$lab, character(1)),
                 collapse = "; "))
  else "the pre-specified safety endpoints (Section 4.3)"
}
tibble::tibble(
  Analysis = c("Patients (PK / efficacy / safety)", "Exposure metric",
               ep_rows$Analysis, "Models", "Covariate selection", "Safety endpoints"),
  Result = c(paste0(n_pk, " / ", n_eff, " / ", n_saf),
             paste0(PK_EXPO, " (", PK_EXPO_LAB, ")",
                    if (HAVE_EOT) paste0("; ", PK_EXPO_EOT) else ""),
             ep_rows$Result,
             "Binary endpoints: logistic regression; time-to-event endpoints: Cox proportional hazards",
             paste(c(if(RUN_EFFEC) "Efficacy: BIC-guided univariable screening",
                     if(RUN_SAFETY && RUN_REGRESSION && length(SAFETY_MODEL_ENDPOINTS))
                       "Designated safety endpoints: BIC-guided stepwise covariate selection"),collapse=". "),
             saf_txt)
) %>% kable(caption = "Synopsis of the exposure-response analyses")

cov_lab <- function(v) {
  lab <- if(v %in% names(COV_LABEL)) COV_LABEL[[v]] else v
  unit <- if(v %in% names(COV_UNIT)) COV_UNIT[[v]] else ""
  paste0(lab,if(!is.na(unit)&&nzchar(unit)) paste0(" (",unit,")") else "")
}
demog_labels <- setNames(vapply(unique(c(CON_COV,CAT_COV,DOSE_VAR)),cov_lab,""),unique(c(CON_COV,CAT_COV,DOSE_VAR)))
albumin_summary <- function(x,unit,lln=NULL) {
  known_units <- c("g/l"=35,"g/dl"=3.5)
  if(length(unit)!=1L || is.na(unit) || !tolower(trimws(unit)) %in% names(known_units))
    return(NULL)
  if(is.null(lln)) lln <- known_units[[tolower(trimws(unit))]]
  if(!is.numeric(lln) || length(lln)!=1L || !is.finite(lln) || lln<=0)
    stop("ALBUMIN_LLN must be a positive value in the declared albumin units")
  values <- num(x)
  valid <- is.finite(values)
  if(!any(valid)) return(NULL)
  n <- sum(valid & values<lln)
  sprintf("Baseline albumin below %s %s was observed in %d of %d efficacy patients with nonmissing values (%.1f%%).",
    format(lln,trim=TRUE),unit,n,sum(valid),100*n/sum(valid))
}
albumin_note <- albumin_summary(pop_eff$ALB,unname(COV_UNIT["ALB"]),ALBUMIN_LLN)
demog <- pmx_patient_characteristics(pop_eff,CON_COV,unique(c(CAT_COV,DOSE_VAR)),demog_labels,
  level_display=cat_level_display,id="SUBJID")

## 4.2 Exposure Efficacy Analysis

```{r efficacy-intro, echo=FALSE}
ep_labs <- vapply(EPS, function(e) e$label, character(1))
ep_kind <- vapply(EPS, function(e) if (e$kind == "binary") "binary" else "time-to-event",
                  character(1))
if(!RUN_EFFEC) {
  cat("No exposure-efficacy analysis was performed.")
} else cat(paste0("Exposure-efficacy analyses were performed for ",
           paste(sprintf("%s (%s)", ep_labs, ep_kind), collapse = ", "),
           " in the efficacy population, against ",
           PK_EXPO, if(LOGPK) " (log-transformed). " else " (untransformed). ", "Each endpoint is analysed the same way: ",
           "the observed event rate by exposure quartile, the individual ",
           "exposure-response plot, and then the exposure-only model, the ",
           "univariable covariate screening and the full model holding the ",
           "retained covariates.\n"))
```

```{r efficacy-loop, eval=RUN_EFFEC, results="asis", echo=FALSE}
for (i in seq_along(EPS)) {
  ep  <- EPS[[i]]
  key <- ep$short
  fit <- tryCatch(ep_fit(ep), error = function(e) {
    message("ER_SCHEMA_MODEL_FAIL ", ep$label, ": ", conditionMessage(e)); NULL })
  if (is.null(fit)) {
    cat("\n### ", sprintf("4.2.%d", i), " ", ep$label, "\n\n",
        "The analysis for this endpoint failed in this dataset and is not reported.\n\n",
        sep = "")
    next
  }
  EP_FIT[[key]] <- fit
  report <- er_endpoint_report(ep,fit,environment())
  EP_COVEFF_OK[[key]] <- report$ep$has_coveff
  EP_FOREST_REASON[[key]] <- report$forest_reason
  cat(knitr::knit_child(text=ep_chunks(report$ep,i),quiet=TRUE,envir=report$envir),sep="\n")
}
```

```{r endpoints-manifest, eval=RUN_EFFEC, include=FALSE}
ep_row <- function(i) {
  ep  <- EPS[[i]]; fit <- EP_FIT[[ep$short]]
  caps <- ep_caps(ep)
  sec  <- sprintf("4.2.%d", i)
  eff_txt <- NA_character_; cov_ret <- character(0)
  if (!is.null(fit) && !is.null(fit$scr)) {
    b <- coef(fit$scr$base); hit <- match(EXPO2,names(b))
    if(!is.na(hit)) {
      se <- summary(fit$scr$base)$coefficients[hit,fit$se_col]
      limits <- exp(b[hit]+c(-1,1)*qnorm(.975)*se)
      eff_txt <- paste0(er_format_coef(exp(b[hit]))," (",
        er_format_coef(limits[1])," - ",er_format_coef(limits[2]),")")
    }
    cov_ret <- fit$scr$retained
  }
  data.frame(endpoint = ep$short, label = ep$label, kind = ep$kind,
             method = caps$method, effect = caps$effect,
             section = sec, sec_plot = paste0(sec, ".1 Graphical analyses for ", ep$label),
             sec_model = if (is.null(fit) || is.null(fit$scr)) NA_character_ else
                         paste0(sec, ".2 ", caps$method, " regression for ", ep$label),
             has_model = !is.null(fit) && !is.null(fit$scr),
             has_forest = isTRUE(EP_COVEFF_OK[[ep$short]]),
             n_total = if (is.null(fit)) NA_integer_ else fit$n_total,
             n_events = if (is.null(fit)) NA_integer_ else fit$n_events,
             effect_text = eff_txt,
             retained = paste(cov_ret, collapse = "; "),
             cap_base = caps$base, cap_univ = caps$univ, cap_full = caps$full,
             cap_median = caps$median %||% NA_character_,
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
if (length(EPS)) {
  EP_MAN <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(EPS), ep_row))
  write.csv(EP_MAN, file.path(OUT_DIR, "endpoints.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  cat("ER_ENDPOINTS_WRITTEN", nrow(EP_MAN), "endpoints\n")
}
```

## 4.3 Exposure Safety Analysis

```{r safety-setup}
SAFETY_DEF <- Filter(function(d) {
  !is.null(d$var) && d$var %in% names(pop_saf) &&
    any(!is.na(as01(pop_saf[[d$var]])))
}, SAFETY_DEF)
if (!length(SAFETY_DEF)) RUN_SAFETY <- FALSE
SAFETY_DEF <- lapply(seq_along(SAFETY_DEF), function(i) {
  d <- SAFETY_DEF[[i]]
  d$sec <- paste0("4.3.", i)
  d$ep <- list(kind="binary",col=d$var,label=d$lab,
    short=paste0("safety_",tolower(d$var)),scm=TRUE)
  d$model <- isTRUE(RUN_REGRESSION) && toupper(d$var) %in% SAFETY_MODEL_ENDPOINTS
  d$cap_rate <- paste0("Event rate of ",d$lab," by exposure quantile")
  d$cap_logi <- paste0("Unadjusted logistic regression for ",d$lab," by exposure")
  d$cap_tte <- paste0("Cumulative event probability for ",d$lab," by exposure quantile")
  d$sec_model <- if(d$model) paste0(d$sec,".1 Logistic regression for ",d$lab) else NA_character_
  raw_event <- as01(pop_saf[[d$var]])
  d$n_events <- sum(raw_event == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  d$n_total <- sum(!is.na(raw_event))
  d
})
message("ER_SCHEMA_SAFETY endpoints: ", length(SAFETY_DEF))

SAFETY_DATA <- SAFETY_EVIDENCE <- SAFETY_TTE_DATA <- SAFETY_MODEL_TEXT <- list()
if(isTRUE(RUN_SAFETY)) for(d in SAFETY_DEF) {
  event <- as01(pop_saf[[d$var]]); exposure <- num(pop_saf[[PK_EXPO]])
  keep <- !is.na(event) & is.finite(exposure) & (!LOGPK | exposure > 0)
  dat <- pop_saf[keep,,drop=FALSE]
  dat[[d$var]] <- event[keep]; dat[[PK_EXPO]] <- exposure[keep]
  grouped <- tryCatch(cut_exposure(dat,PK_EXPO),error=function(e) NULL)
  quartiles <- if(is.null(grouped)) data.frame() else do.call(rbind,lapply(levels(grouped[[PK_EXPO]]),function(g) {
    hit <- !is.na(grouped[[PK_EXPO]]) & grouped[[PK_EXPO]]==g
    y <- dat[[d$var]][hit]; ci <- if(length(y)) binom.test(sum(y),length(y))$conf.int else c(NA_real_,NA_real_)
    data.frame(group=g,n=length(y),events=sum(y),exposure_median=median(dat[[PK_EXPO]][hit]),
      event_rate=if(length(y)) mean(y) else NA_real_,lower=ci[1],upper=ci[2],row.names=NULL)
  }))
  SAFETY_DATA[[d$var]] <- dat
  SAFETY_EVIDENCE[[d$var]] <- list(endpoint=d$var,label=d$lab,section=paste(d$sec,d$lab),
    exposure=PK_EXPO,exposure_label=PK_EXPO_LAB,exposure_scale=if(LOGPK) "log" else "raw",
    n_evaluable=nrow(dat),events=sum(dat[[d$var]]),non_events=sum(dat[[d$var]]==0),
    excluded_missing_exposure_or_endpoint=sum(!keep),quartiles=quartiles,
    confidence=.95,rate_scale="proportion",rate_interval_method="exact binomial",
    bar_error_bars="upper arm of one standard error",trend_review="pending",
    curve_role="unadjusted logistic display",adjusted_model=FALSE,
    model_key=if(d$model) d$ep$short else NULL,
    model_state=if(d$model) "pending" else "not_requested",
    plots_available=!is.null(grouped) && sum(dat[[d$var]])>=3)
  if (isTRUE(RUN_SAFETY_TTE) && !is.null(d$time) && d$time %in% names(pop_saf)) {
    tm <- num(pop_saf[[d$time]])
    km_exposure <- if(HAVE_EOT) PK_EXPO_EOT else PK_EXPO
    valid <- is.finite(tm) & !is.na(event) & is.finite(num(pop_saf[[km_exposure]]))
    dd <- pop_saf[valid,,drop=FALSE]
    dd[[d$time]] <- tm[valid]
    dd[[d$var]] <- event[valid]
    if(nrow(dd)>=3 && any(dd[[d$var]]==1) &&
       !is.null(tryCatch(cut_exposure(dd,km_exposure),error=function(e) NULL)))
      SAFETY_TTE_DATA[[d$var]] <- dd
  }
}
safety_placeholder <- function(label) paste0("[Exposure-safety trend for ",label,": interpretation pending.]")

saf_events <- do.call(rbind, lapply(SAFETY_DEF, function(d) {
  data.frame(Endpoint = d$lab,
             N = d$n_total,
             Events = d$n_events,
             `Patients (%)` = round(100 * d$n_events / d$n_total, 1),
             check.names = FALSE)
}))
if (!is.null(saf_events) && nrow(saf_events)) {
  kable(saf_events, format="html",caption="Summary of exposure-safety endpoints (safety population)",
    align="lccc",table.attr='class="table safety-endpoints"')
} else {
  cat("No evaluable pre-specified safety endpoints were supplied.\n")
}
```

```{r safety-figures, eval=RUN_SAFETY, results="asis"}
for (d in SAFETY_DEF) {
  cat("\n\n### ", d$sec, " ", d$lab, "\n\n", sep="")
  cat(safety_placeholder(d$lab),"\n\n")
  dat <- SAFETY_DATA[[d$var]]
  ep <- d$ep
  body <- character()
  ce <- new.env(parent=environment())
  ce$SAF_D <- d
  ce$SAF_DAT <- dat
  fit <- if(d$model) ep_fit(ep,dat)
  ce$SAF_BASE <- fit$scr$base
  if (isTRUE(SAFETY_EVIDENCE[[d$var]]$plots_available)) {
    ce$SAF_REG <- if(DOSE_VAR %in% names(dat) && any(!is.na(dat[[DOSE_VAR]]))) DOSE_VAR else NA
    body <- c(body,
      sprintf("```{r %s-rate, fig.width=7.2, fig.height=5.2, fig.cap=SAF_D$cap_rate}",ep$short),
      "plot.rate(SAF_DAT,SAF_D$var,SAF_D$lab)","```","",
      sprintf("```{r %s-logi, fig.width=7.2, fig.height=6, fig.cap=SAF_D$cap_logi}",ep$short),
      "print(plot.logi(SAF_DAT,ev_var=SAF_D$var,y_lab=paste0(SAF_D$lab,' (%)'),reg=SAF_REG,reg_lab=REG_LABEL,curve=SAF_BASE))",
      "```","")
  } else body <- c(body,"Insufficient evaluable events or exposure groups for exposure-response plots.","")
  dd <- SAFETY_TTE_DATA[[d$var]]
  if(!is.null(dd)) {
    ce$SAF_TTE <- dd
    body <- c(body,
      sprintf("```{r %s-km, fig.width=7.5, fig.height=6, fig.cap=SAF_D$cap_tte}",ep$short),
      "km.plot(SAF_TTE,pkvar=if(HAVE_EOT) PK_EXPO_EOT else PK_EXPO,timevar=SAF_D$time,",
      "        evvar=SAF_D$var,direction='up',legend=PK_EXPO_LAB)",
      "```","")
  }
  cat(knitr::knit_child(text=body,quiet=TRUE,envir=ce),sep="\n")
  if(d$model) {
    EP_FIT[[ep$short]] <- fit
    report <- er_endpoint_report(ep,fit,environment())
    EP_COVEFF_OK[[ep$short]] <- report$ep$has_coveff
    EP_FOREST_REASON[[ep$short]] <- report$forest_reason
    evidence <- SAFETY_EVIDENCE[[d$var]]
    evidence$model_state <- if(is.null(fit$scr)) "not_estimable" else "available"
    evidence$model_reason <- fit$regression_error
    evidence$adjusted_model <- length(fit$scr$retained)>0L
    SAFETY_EVIDENCE[[d$var]] <- evidence
    SAFETY_MODEL_TEXT[[d$sec_model]] <- er_model_text(report$ep)
    cat(knitr::knit_child(text=ep_model_chunks(report$ep,d$sec_model),quiet=TRUE,envir=report$envir),sep="\n")
  }
}
```

```{r safety-manifest, eval=RUN_SAFETY, include=FALSE}
if (length(SAFETY_DEF)) {
  SAF_MAN <- do.call(rbind, lapply(SAFETY_DEF, function(d) {
    has_tte <- !is.null(SAFETY_TTE_DATA[[d$var]])
    data.frame(endpoint = d$var, label = d$lab,
               section = d$sec, sec_full = paste0(d$sec, " ", d$lab),
               n_total = d$n_total, n_events = d$n_events,
               sec_model = d$sec_model, has_model = !is.null(EP_FIT[[d$ep$short]]$scr),
               has_forest = isTRUE(EP_COVEFF_OK[[d$ep$short]]),
               n_figures = 2L*isTRUE(SAFETY_EVIDENCE[[d$var]]$plots_available) +
                 as.integer(has_tte) + as.integer(isTRUE(EP_COVEFF_OK[[d$ep$short]])),
               has_tte = has_tte, cap_rate = d$cap_rate, cap_logi = d$cap_logi, cap_tte = d$cap_tte,
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }))
  write.csv(SAF_MAN, file.path(OUT_DIR, "safety_endpoints.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  cat("ER_SAFETY_WRITTEN", nrow(SAF_MAN), "endpoints\n")
}

  }
