```{r report-result-contract, include=FALSE}
dir.create(OUT_DIR,showWarnings=FALSE)
models <- list()
for(k in names(EP_FIT)) {
  x <- EP_FIT[[k]]; if(is.null(x$scr)) next
  fit <- x$scr$full; co <- summary(fit)$coefficients
  parameter_table <- model_out(fit,x$se_col,x$effect)
  models[[k]] <- list(endpoint=x$ep$label,kind=x$effect,exposure=EXPO2,
    term_labels=er_model_term_labels(fit),
    parameter_table=parameter_table,
    parameter_bold_labels=attr(parameter_table,"bold_labels"),
    estimates=data.frame(term=rownames(co),estimate=as.numeric(co[,1]),se=as.numeric(co[,x$se_col]),
      p_value=2*pnorm(-abs(co[,1]/co[,x$se_col])),stringsAsFactors=FALSE),
    assessment=x$scr$assessment,failed_covariates=x$scr$failed,
    selection_method=if(isTRUE(x$ep$scm)) "Stepwise BIC" else "Univariable screening",
    scm=x$scr$scm,
    full_equals_base=er_full_equals_base(x$scr),
    screening_evaluable=if(isTRUE(x$ep$scm)) sum(is.finite(x$scr$scm$Delta_BIC)) else nrow(x$scr$univ %||% data.frame()),
    forest=list(state=if(isTRUE(EP_COVEFF_OK[[k]])) "available" else "not_estimable",reason=EP_FOREST_REASON[[k]]),
    n=nrow(model.frame(fit)),base_n=nrow(model.frame(x$scr$base)),retained=unique(x$scr$retained),formula=paste(deparse(formula(fit)),collapse=" "),
    base_formula=paste(deparse(formula(x$scr$base)),collapse=" "),
    base_estimates=data.frame(term=names(coef(x$scr$base)),estimate=as.numeric(coef(x$scr$base)),
      se=as.numeric(summary(x$scr$base)$coefficients[,x$se_col]),stringsAsFactors=FALSE),
    n_endpoint=x$n_total,n_events=x$n_events,event_definition=if(x$ep$kind=="binary") x$ep$col else x$ep$evvar,
    categorical_contrasts=lapply(Filter(is.factor,model.frame(fit)),function(v) list(reference=levels(v)[1],levels=levels(v))),
    uncertainty=list(coefficient_scale=if(x$effect=="OR") "log odds" else "log hazard",rse="100 * SE / abs(coefficient)",confidence=.95))
}
report_sections <- list(
  Introduction=paste0("This report describes associations between ",PK_EXPO_LAB," and the efficacy and safety endpoints in the supplied analysis dataset. Fitted associations do not by themselves establish causality or a dosing recommendation."),
  Objectives="Evaluate exposure associations with efficacy and designated safety endpoints and assess covariates using the specified screening procedures.",
  DataAssembly=paste0("The patient-level file ",basename(DATA_FILE)," supplies exposure, endpoints and covariates. Analysis populations use the available PKFL, EFFFL and SAFEFL flags; the report performs no dataset merge."),
  DataHandling="Models use complete cases for their required variables without imputation. Each covariate comparison uses the same rows for the candidate and reference models. P05/P95 versus median are the reported contrasts for continuous covariates.",
  ExposureMeasures=paste0("The primary exposure measure is ",PK_EXPO_LAB,". Regression uses ",if(LOGPK) "natural-log" else "raw"," exposure. The model formula identifies the exposure term actually fitted for each endpoint."),
  Methods=c(er_method_text(),er_safety_method()),
  CovariateAnalysis=er_covariate_method(),
  Software=paste0("Exposure-response analyses were conducted using R version ",getRversion(),"."),
  References=REPORT_REFERENCES)
section_results <- list(
  "4.1 Patient Population"=c("Patient characteristics are summarized in the baseline characteristics table; analysis populations are detailed in the disposition table.",albumin_note),
  "4.1.1 Patient Population For Exposure-Efficacy Analysis"="Endpoint-specific efficacy populations use evaluable exposure and endpoint records.",
  "4.1.2 Patient Population for Exposure-Safety Analysis"="Endpoint-specific safety populations use evaluable exposure and event records.")
for(i in seq_along(EPS)) {
  ep <- EPS[[i]]; x <- EP_FIT[[ep$short]]
  if(is.null(x)) next
  caps <- ep_caps(ep);sec <- paste0("4.2.",i)
  section_results[[paste(sec,ep$label)]] <- character()
  plot_section <- paste0(sec,".1 Graphical analyses for ",ep$label)
  section_results[[plot_section]] <- er_result_placeholder(ep)
  ep$scr <- x$scr
  ep$regression_error <- x$regression_error
  section_results[[paste0(sec,".2 ",caps$method," regression for ",ep$label)]] <- er_model_text(ep)
}
if(isTRUE(RUN_SAFETY) && exists("SAFETY_DEF")) for(d in SAFETY_DEF) {
  section_results[[paste(d$sec,d$lab)]] <- safety_placeholder(d$lab)
}
section_results <- c(section_results,SAFETY_MODEL_TEXT)
saveRDS(list(schema=1L,family="er",data_md5=unname(tools::md5sum(DATA_FILE)),
  models=models,exposure_label=PK_EXPO_LAB,scale=if(LOGPK) "log" else "raw",
  report_sections=report_sections,section_results=section_results,safety=SAFETY_EVIDENCE,
  covariates=list(derivations=lapply(COV_DERIVE,function(f) paste(deparse(f),collapse=" ")),continuous=CON_COV,categorical=CAT_COV,labels=COV_LABEL,units=COV_UNIT,levels=COV_LEVELS)),
  file.path(OUT_DIR,"report_results.rds"))
```
